---
title: "Full-day"
subtitle: "Four parts, with a facilitator"
---

In this format you work for one day as analyst no. 6 on the Europeanisation and the economy case study. Its original author (OA) asked whether the economic crisis changed how citizens of the member states frame the European Union, and five analysts reanalysed one claim of the paper for the SCORE robustness study (Aczel et al. 2026).

## How you work

:::: {.fmt-steps}

::: {.fmt-step}
### webR {.unnumbered .unlisted}

The slides carry every step of the tasks in cells that run R in the browser through [webR](https://docs.r-wasm.org/webr/latest/), a version of R compiled to run inside a web page, and the webR workspace holds the same tasks on a page of the workshop's website. Without R and an IDE, or if your installation fails, you can do every task there, with hints and worked solutions, and obtain the same numbers as in the IDE workspace.

[Open the slides](../../live/day.html){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Open the webR workspace](../../lab.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}
:::

::: {.fmt-step}
### R and an IDE {.unnumbered .unlisted}

Install R, Quarto and an IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.) before the day, following the steps for your operating system.

[Setup](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/setup.html){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}
:::

::: {.fmt-step}
### The IDE workspace {#the-workspace .unnumbered .unlisted}

Download the IDE workspace of the case study as a zip file, open its folder and run its setup check. You do the tasks in its report, which you keep afterwards.

[The IDE workspace](before.qmd#the-workspace){.btn .btn-primary}
:::

::::

The day runs in four parts, with a break after the first and the third and lunch after the second.
